UNANIMOUS WRITTEN CONSENT OF THE BOARD OF DIRECTORS

APOLLO DEFENSE TECHNOLOGIES CORP - DELAWARE GENERAL CORPORATION LAW SECTION 141(f)

The undersigned, being all the members of the Board of Directors of APOLLO DEFENSE TECHNOLOGIES CORP, a Delaware corporation (the 'Corporation'), hereby unanimously consent in writing to the adoption of the following resolutions pursuant to Section 141(f) of the DGCL.

SERIES B PREFERRED STOCK FINANCING RESOLUTIONS.

WHEREAS, the Board deems it to be in the best financial interests of the Corporation and its stockholders to issue and sell up to 12,500,000 shares of Series B Preferred Stock at a purchase price of $4.80 per share, for an aggregate gross proceeds of $60,000,000.00, pursuant to the Series B Stock Purchase Agreement presented to the Board.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED, that the Certificate of Incorporation of the Corporation be amended and restated in its entirety (the 'Restated Certificate') to increase the authorized Common Stock to 120,000,000 shares and the authorized Preferred Stock to 35,000,000 shares, per value $0.0001 per share.

FURTHER RESOLVED, that the Chief Executive Officer, the Chief Financial Officer, and the Secretary are each authorized to execute and deliver the Series B Purchase Agreement, the Investors' Rights Agreement, the Right of First Refusal and Co-Sale Agreement, and the Voting Agreement on behalf of the Corporation.

FURTHER RESOLVED, that an aggregate of 3,500,000 shares of Common Stock be newly reserved for issuance under the 2024 Equity Incentive Plan for key engineering personnel.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the undersigned have executed this Written Consent as of October 28, 2024. Signatures: Thomas H. Vance, Chairman, Victoria M. Starting, Director, Dr Raymond Chen, Director.

SUB-TIER DEFENSE PROCUREMENT SPECIFICATION & STATEMENT OF WORK

CONTRACT NO: N00019-24-C-8491 | DEFENSE LOGISTICS AGENCY (DLA) | CAGE: 18491

SECTION C: STATEMENT OF WORK (SOW) - HIGH STRENGTH HY-80 STEEL PRESSURE HULL FABRICATION

1. SCOPE: This specification establishes the minimum metallurgical, ultrasonic, and radiographic testing requirements for structural submarine hull penetration collars installed on Virginia-class submarines.

2. APPLICABLE MILITARY SPECIFICATIONS: MIL. STD. 16216 (Steel Plate, Alloy Structural, High Shield Strength HY-80 and HY-100) NAVSEA Technical Publication T9074-AD-GIB-010-1688 (Requirements for Fabrication, Welding and Inspection of Submarine Structure). MIL. STD. 7035 (Ultrasonic Inspection Acceptance Criteria).

3. QUALITY ASSURANCE PROVISIONS: Contractor shall maintain an ISO 9001 AS9100 certified quality management system. 100% of all full-penetration butt welds shall undergo magnetic particle testing (MTS) per ASTM E1444 and volumetric radiographical testing (RT) per ASTM E1742 Level 2-1T sensitivity.

4. TRACEABILITY & MATERIAL TEST REPORTS: Certified Material Test Reports (CMTR) documenting chemical melt analysis (C: Mn, P, S, Si, Ni, Cr, Mo, V) and Charpy V-Notch impact energy (minimum: 60 ft-lbs at 170 deg F) shall accompany each delivery lot.

ON JUDICIAL COOPERATION / TRATTATO DI COOPERAZIONE GIUDIZIARIA
BILATERAL CONVENTION IT/US - RATIFIED BY ACT OF CONGRESS & PARLAMENTO ITALIANO

ARTICLE 14 (EXTRADITION AND MUTUAL LEGAL ASSISTANCE - ESTRADIZIONE ED ASSISTENZA GIUDIZIARIA)

EN Each Contracting State undertakes to surrender to the other, in accordance with the provisions of this Treaty, any person who is found in its territory and is requested by the competent judicial authorities for prosecution, extraditable offense carrying a maximum penalty of deprivation of liberty exceeding one year.

IT Ciascuno Stato contraente si obbliga ad estradare verso l'altro, in conformità alle norme del presente Trattato, le persone che si trovino sul suo territorio e siano perseguite dalle competenti autonta giudiziarie per reatti puniti restrittiva della libertà personale superiore ad un anno.

ARTICLE 15 (DOUBLE JEOPARDY AND NE BIS IN IDEM - DIVIETO DI DOPPIO GIUDIZIO)

EN Extradition shall not be granted if the person sought has been tried and convicted or acquitted in the Requested State for the identical acts and offenses upon which the request for extradition is founded.

IT Lestraduzione non sara concessa qualora la persona richesta sia gia stata giudicata con sentenza definitiva di condanna o proscriglamento nello Stato richesto per i medesimi fatti reato.

ARTICLE 16 (TRANSLATION AND AUTHENTICATION - TRADUZIONE ED AUTENTICAZIONE)

EN IT All formal rogatory requests, affidavits, court warrants, and evidentary exhibits shall be accompanied by an official certified translation into the language of the Requested State.
